nativeBehavior.UrlStatus: The pinned configuration declares this separate accepted role. The pinned renderer has no explicit A.UrlStatus read, so equivalence with DeadURL is not established.
nativeBehavior.DeadURL: The pinned renderer reads this role, defaults it to não and lowercases it. Its main original/archive-URL and inactive-link branches distinguish não/no from other supplied values. Dated markers and non-boolean values must not be reduced to guessed booleans.
counterexamples: url-status=yes must not become an active urlmorta=sim field.
urlmorta=live must not become não, because the main inactive-link condition does not treat live as a negative value.

helperMeaning: Returns the original exact key and value only. This is preservation evidence and does not authorize foreign-template migration.
foreignBoundary: A genuine foreign UrlStatus source requires separate role and value semantics. The native accepted-field proof does not establish such a migration.
